Independently, on or after day five the payer can call rescue_release from funded to settled with exactly the same 75/25 split, if the reviewer will not act. Each payment is one-time and atomic. There are no additional actions, automatic transactions or refund options after the deadline.

After the deadline begins, reviewer has release to settle 75 percent to worker and 25 percent to reviewer. If reviewer declines, payer possesses another action explicitly named rescue_release, valid from funded at or after the deadline, to settle the same proportions into settled. No other contract functions change the state. There is no autonomous execution.

The deployer payer deposits 3 ETH exactly once. Worker and reviewer are distinct addresses supplied to the constructor. Funding starts a deadline of seven days. If the state is still funded at or after seven days, payer may call refund to refund all ETH to payer. To prevent payer inactivity causing a lock, worker has a separate fallback_approve action in submitted at or after seven days, settling all ETH to worker. Worker also has fallback_refund from funded at or after seven days which refunds the entire deposit to payer. No further transitions, recurring payments, or automatic transactions are authorized.
